files.role: C1 dump archive (Stack Exchange data dump, cooking.stackexchange.com)
frame U-SE units (questions PostTypeId 1, answers PostTypeId 2)
attribution (author display names), never a frame unit

licence.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) for posts and comments created on or after 2018-05-02; CC BY-SA 3.0 for 2011-04-08 to 2018-05-01; CC BY-SA 2.5 before 2011-04-08 (licence chosen per item by its CreationDate, as SOURCES.md row 5 says)
attribution_requirements: name the author (display name) of each item used
link to the item on cooking.stackexchange.com (question / answer: /q/<PostId> or /a/<PostId>; comment: the post link)
name the source: Seasoned Advice (cooking.stackexchange.com), Stack Exchange network
state the licence (CC BY-SA, version by item date) and indicate changes (sentence split, HTML stripped)
share-alike: any derivative text published carries the same licence
licence.kept_per_item: id, post id, author user id / display name, creation date (licence version); files stay internal
licence.note: archive.org also holds license.txt in the same item; not fetched (not a URL SOURCES.md names)

network_rule: only the two URLs SOURCES.md row 5 names; neutral User-Agent, no '@' (test_fetch_no_email.py PASS)
untrusted: never executed; read only by use1 scripts with python -I
